Honey halloumi tacos

Ingredients

For the halloumi

  • 250g/9oz halloumi, cut into 1½–2cm/½–¾in cubes
  • 2 tbsp runny honey
  • 1 tbsp cider vinegar
  • 1 tbsp olive oil

For the slaw

  • ½ orange, zest and juice
  • small bunch fresh mint
  • 15g pickled red onion, plus 1 tbsp of the pickling liquid
  • 3 tbsp natural yoghurt
  • ¼ red cabbage, finely sliced

To serve

  • 8 small flour tortillas, warmed
  • lime wedges, to serve
  • hot sauce (optional)

Method

  1. Fry the halloumi in the oil over a high heat for 6–8 minutes, turning, until golden on every side.

  2. Stir in the honey and vinegar and bubble until sticky.

  3. Blend the mint, pickled onion, pickling liquid and yoghurt, then toss with the cabbage and orange.

  4. Fill the tortillas with slaw and halloumi and serve with lime wedges and hot sauce.
